Game Overview

Mission Impossible-Save Christmas is a arcade game built around guide Santa's extraordinary hat in this festive arcade adventure to retrieve lost gifts. Navigate pixelated landscapes, collecting green presents to boost your score while skillfully dodging the tricky red ones. Simple controls, strategic movement, and a cheerful theme create an addictive holiday experience.
